spots.name: Mount Billy Mitchell
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 2,200 m (7,218 ft).

spots.name: Thompson Pass
spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.

spots.name: Worthington Glacier Viewpoint
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing west. Good for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Keystone Canyon
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Bridalveil Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.
